fields.description: The type of action to perform when the rule is met.
fields.label: Action Type
fields.options:
Set Field Value
Apply Template To Field
Call Registered Method
Raise Alert (Error)
Raise Alert (Warning)
Raise Alert (Info)
Notify Users
Set Context Variable
Create Normalization Record
Create Data Monitoring

fields.description: Defines the scope where the action will be applied.
fields.label: Action Target Scope
fields.options:
Current Document
Related Document
System
User Context

fields.description: For 'Related Document', specify the field name containing the link (e.g., 'customer'). For 'System'/'User Context', specify component/user ID. Supports Jinja.
fields.label: Target Identifier / Related Document Field

fields.depends_on: eval:['Set Field Value','Apply Template To Field', 'Set Context Variable'].includes(doc.action_type)
fields.description: The field name to modify on the target (document or context variable name).
fields.label: Target Field (on Doc/Context)
Value Source
fields.options:
Literal Value
Doc Field
Registered Method Result
Dynamic Template
Context Variable

fields.depends_on: eval:['Set Field Value', 'Set Context Variable'].includes(doc.action_type) && ['Literal Value', 'Doc Field', 'Context Variable'].includes(doc.value_source_type)
fields.label: Value (Literal/Doc Field/Context Key)

fields.depends_on: eval:['Set Field Value', 'Set Context Variable'].includes(doc.action_type) && doc.value_source_type == 'Dynamic Template'
fields.label: Dynamic Template (for Value)

fields.depends_on: eval:['Call Registered Method', 'Set Field Value', 'Set Context Variable'].includes(doc.action_type) && doc.value_source_type == 'Registered Method Result'
fields.label: Registered Method (for Value/Call)

fields.depends_on: eval:['Call Registered Method', 'Set Field Value', 'Set Context Variable'].includes(doc.action_type) && doc.value_source_type == 'Registered Method Result'
fields.description: JSON object of parameters for the method (e.g., {'param_name': '{{ doc.value }}'}). Supports Jinja templating.
fields.label: Parameters (JSON)

fields.description: Message to display/send. Supports Jinja templating.
fields.label: Alert Message

fields.description: Comma-separated email addresses/user names, or a Webhook URL. Supports Jinja templating.
fields.label: Recipients / Webhook URL

fields.description: Optional: Use a template for email body or webhook payload content.
fields.label: Notification Template (Optional)

fields.description: Defines when this action will be executed. 'Background' actions are put in a queue.
fields.label: Execution Mode
